findings.text: test_golden_without_a_committed_file_splits_as_new builds its expected value by calling assign_group_splits -- the same function _finish itself calls -- so both sides of the comparison at :147 move together and the assertion stays green for any behaviour of assign_group_splits; it guards only the copy_group-to-split wiring of _finish, not the no-committed-file split rule the brief assigns it.

_committed_group_splits re-reads a committed golden with a raw json.loads(path.read_text()) at imas_codex/standard_names/judgment_goldens.py:102-107 instead of the repository owner load_labelled_fixture (imas_codex/discovery/base/evaluation.py:70), which reads and validates the same labelled-fixture files; the absent-file tolerance and the copy_group-to-split projection are new, but the raw read bypasses the owner's row validation, so a malformed committed split propagates into the rebuild instead of being refused by name and row index.
